senses.en: a person or thing added to something
senses.pattern: a new addition to the family / a welcome addition / the latest addition to the team
senses.example: The baby panda is the latest [[addition]] to the zoo, and visitors line up for hours to see it.
senses.example_zh: 這隻熊貓寶寶是動物園最新加入的成員，遊客排好幾個小時的隊就為了看牠。
senses.note: 常接 to：an addition to＋團體、收藏

gsat.sentence: The new [[addition]] to Morgan’s Wonderland.

senses.en: wanting very much to do or have something
senses.pattern: be anxious to do / be anxious for news / be anxious that
senses.example: After a month in the hospital, Grandpa was [[anxious]] to get home and see his garden again.
senses.example_zh: 住院一個月後，爺爺急切地想回家，再看看他的花園。
senses.note: anxious to V／for N 表「渴望」

senses.en: the people or organizations with official power
senses.pattern: the local authorities / the health authorities / report sth to the authorities
senses.example: The local [[authorities]] closed the beach after several swimmers were stung by jellyfish.
senses.example_zh: 數名泳客被水母螫傷後，地方當局關閉了這片海灘。
senses.note: 此義常用複數 the authorities

senses.en: a person with special knowledge of a subject
senses.pattern: an authority on / a leading authority / a world authority on
senses.example: Professor Lin is a leading [[authority]] on ancient coins, so museums often ask for her advice.
senses.example_zh: 林教授是古錢幣方面首屈一指的權威人士，因此博物館常向她請教。

gsat.sentence: In medieval Europe, on the other hand, travel documents were issued by local [[authorities]], and generally contained a list of towns and cities which the document holder was permitted to enter or pass through.

However, a man known as Mestre Bimba devoted a great deal of time and effort to convincing the Brazilian [[authorities]] that Capoeira has great cultural value and should become an official fighting style.

senses.en: to be in the right or suitable place
senses.pattern: belong in the kitchen / belong on the shelf / put sth back where it belongs
senses.example: Please put the dictionaries back on the top shelf, where they [[belong]], when you finish using them.
senses.example_zh: 字典用完後，請放回最上層書架，那才是它們應在的地方。
senses.note: 此義不接 to，後接地方副詞或介系詞片語

senses.en: to feel comfortable and accepted in a group
senses.pattern: feel that you belong / belong here / a sense of belonging
senses.example: As a transfer student, Mia felt she didn't [[belong]] until the drama club welcomed her.
senses.example_zh: 身為轉學生，米亞一直沒有歸屬感，直到戲劇社接納了她。

senses.en: a lucky chance that leads to success
senses.pattern: a big break / a lucky break / get one's big break
senses.example: The young singer got her big [[break]] when a famous director heard her perform at a small café.
senses.example_zh: 一位名導演在小咖啡館聽到這位年輕歌手演唱，她因此得到成名的大好機會。

senses.en: to tell someone news or make it public first
senses.pattern: break the news to sb / break a story / break it to sb gently
senses.example: The doctor sat down beside the family and gently [[broke]] the bad news to them.
senses.example_zh: 醫生在家屬身旁坐下，委婉地向他們透露這個壞消息。
senses.note: 消息傳開也可說 The news broke.

senses.en: done without much care or thought
senses.pattern: a casual remark / a casual glance / a casual attitude toward
senses.example: It was only a [[casual]] remark, but it hurt his feelings more than she had realized.
senses.example_zh: 那只是漫不經心的一句話，卻比她所意識到的更傷他的心。

senses.en: (of work or workers) temporary, not regular
senses.pattern: casual workers / casual labor / a casual job
senses.example: During the harvest season, the farm hires [[casual]] workers who are paid by the day.
senses.example_zh: 採收季期間，農場會雇用按日計酬的臨時工。

senses.en: a group of people with shared interests or jobs
senses.pattern: academic circles / business circles / a circle of friends
senses.example: The young scientist's discovery quickly became well known in academic [[circles]] around the world.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕科學家的發現很快就在全球學術界廣為人知。

senses.en: to move in a circle, especially in the air
senses.pattern: circle overhead / circle above the field / circle around
senses.example: An eagle [[circled]] high above the valley, searching for its next meal.
senses.example_zh: 一隻老鷹在山谷上空高高盤旋，尋找下一餐。

gsat.sentence: The fashion soon spread beyond the [[circle]] of the nobility to the middle classes, and tea became a popular drink at the London coffee houses where people met to do business and discuss events of the day.

senses.en: knowledge of and skill in something, especially a language
senses.pattern: a good command of English / have command of / an excellent command of
senses.example: Thanks to her excellent [[command]] of Japanese, Rita was chosen to guide the visiting exchange students.
senses.example_zh: 由於日語運用能力極佳，麗塔獲選為來訪的交換學生擔任嚮導。
senses.note: 常用 a good command of＋語言

senses.en: to deserve and get respect, attention, or a high price
senses.pattern: command respect / command attention / command a high price
senses.example: The doctor's honesty and skill [[command]] the trust of everyone in the small town.
senses.example_zh: 這位醫生的誠實與醫術，博得了小鎮上每個人的信任。

gsat.sentence: With a good [[command]] of both Chinese and English, Miss Lin was assigned the task of oral interpretation for the visiting American delegation.
Some coins may [[command]] higher prices because they are more popular with collectors.

senses.en: to eat or drink something
senses.pattern: consume alcohol / consume calories / consume too much sugar
senses.example: Doctors advise adults to [[consume]] less sugar and at least five servings of vegetables a day.
senses.example_zh: 醫生建議成人少攝取糖分，並且每天至少吃五份蔬菜。

senses.en: (of a feeling) to fill someone's mind completely
senses.pattern: be consumed by guilt / be consumed with jealousy / be consumed by fear
senses.example: After the accident, he was [[consumed]] by guilt and could hardly sleep at night.
senses.example_zh: 意外發生後，他被愧疚感吞噬，夜裡幾乎無法入睡。

gsat.sentence: Today, tea can be drunk at any time of the day, and accounts for over two-fifths of all beverages [[consumed]] in Britain—with the exception of water.
However, alcohol could not be detected for any of the drinks if the test was given 15 minutes after the drink was [[consumed]].

senses.en: extremely important to how things will develop
senses.pattern: be critical to success / a critical factor / play a critical role
senses.example: Getting enough sleep is [[critical]] to students' memory and their performance on exams.
senses.example_zh: 充足的睡眠對學生的記憶力和考試表現極為關鍵。

senses.en: very serious or dangerous; possibly near death
senses.pattern: in critical condition / a critical shortage / critically ill
senses.example: Two passengers remain in [[critical]] condition after the bus crashed into a bridge last night.
senses.example_zh: 昨晚公車撞上橋梁後，兩名乘客目前傷勢仍然危急。

gsat.sentence: As blood supplies have fallen to a [[critically]] low level, many hospitals are making an appeal for the public to donate blood.
As the world population continues to grow, shortages of fresh water will occur more often and the need for additional water supplies will become [[critical]].

senses.en: to begin to have an illness or problem
senses.pattern: develop cancer / develop a fever / develop an allergy to
senses.example: People who breathe polluted air for years are more likely to [[develop]] lung disease.
senses.example_zh: 長年呼吸受污染空氣的人，比較容易罹患肺部疾病。

senses.en: to make photographs from film using chemicals
senses.pattern: develop film / develop photos / have the pictures developed
senses.example: Before digital cameras, people had to wait days for a shop to [[develop]] their film.
senses.example_zh: 在數位相機問世前，人們得等上好幾天讓店家沖洗底片。

gsat.sentence: This suggests that napping may significantly delay age-related brain shrinkage, and thus lower the possibility of [[developing]] dementia.
Children under 14 who watch horror movies have a greater chance of [[developing]] anxiety later in adulthood.

senses.en: something that makes an important thing happen or grow
senses.pattern: a key driver of growth / the main driver of / a driver of change
senses.example: Tourism has been the main [[driver]] of economic growth on the island for two decades.
senses.example_zh: 二十年來，觀光業一直是島上經濟成長的主要推手。

senses.en: software that controls a piece of computer equipment
senses.pattern: install a driver / update the driver / a printer driver
senses.example: The printer would not work until I installed the latest [[driver]] on my laptop.
senses.example_zh: 直到我在筆電上安裝了最新的驅動程式，印表機才能運作。

senses.en: to put your name down for a contest or exam
senses.pattern: enter a contest / enter a competition / enter a race
senses.example: More than two hundred students [[entered]] the school's annual poster design competition this spring.
senses.example_zh: 今年春天有兩百多名學生報名參加學校一年一度的海報設計比賽。

senses.en: to begin a career or become involved in an activity
senses.pattern: enter the teaching profession / enter politics / enter the job market
senses.example: Many graduates [[enter]] the teaching profession hoping to make a difference in children's lives.
senses.example_zh: 許多畢業生懷著改變孩子人生的期望投身教職。

gsat.sentence: She was invited to [[enter]] an invention contest held by her school.

senses.en: a large public event with goods or displays
senses.pattern: a book fair / a job fair / a science fair / a trade fair
senses.example: Dozens of local farmers will sell fresh fruit and honey at the county [[fair]] this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 本週末將有數十位當地農民在縣內的市集販售新鮮水果和蜂蜜。

senses.en: (of skin or hair) pale or light in color
senses.pattern: fair skin / fair hair / a fair complexion
senses.example: Because of her [[fair]] skin, Emma always wears a hat and sunscreen at the beach.
senses.example_zh: 由於皮膚白皙，艾瑪在海邊總是戴帽子並擦防曬乳。

senses.en: quite large in amount, size, or number
senses.pattern: a fair amount of / a fair number of / a fair distance
senses.example: It takes a [[fair]] amount of patience to teach a puppy where to sleep.
senses.example_zh: 教小狗該在哪裡睡覺，需要相當多的耐心。

gsat.sentence: At the Book [[Fair]], exhibitors from 21 countries will display textbooks, novels, and comic books.
Two years later, it was awarded first prize again at Houston’s first annual Invention [[Fair]].

senses.en: a sudden short attack of emotion, coughing, or laughter
senses.pattern: a fit of anger / a coughing fit / in a fit of jealousy
senses.example: In a [[fit]] of anger, the boy threw his phone on the floor and cracked the screen.
senses.example_zh: 男孩一時怒氣發作，把手機摔在地上，螢幕都裂了。

senses.en: suitable or good enough for a purpose
senses.pattern: fit to drink / fit to eat / fit for human consumption
senses.example: After the flood, the tap water was not [[fit]] to drink for nearly a week.
senses.example_zh: 水災過後，自來水有將近一週都不適合飲用。
senses.note: 句型：be fit to V／fit for N

senses.en: the line where warm and cold air masses meet
senses.pattern: a cold front / a warm front / a front moves in
senses.example: A cold [[front]] will arrive tonight, so temperatures may drop by ten degrees tomorrow morning.
senses.example_zh: 冷鋒面今晚報到，明天早上氣溫可能下降十度。

senses.en: a particular area of activity
senses.pattern: on the economic front / on the education front / on all fronts
senses.example: On the health [[front]], the report shows that teenagers are sleeping less than ever before.
senses.example_zh: 在健康方面，報告顯示青少年的睡眠時間比以往都少。
senses.note: 介系詞用 on：on the … front

senses.en: to stay in the air or over a place
senses.pattern: hang over the city / hang in the air / hang low
senses.example: A thick cloud of smoke [[hung]] over the town for days after the forest fire.
senses.example_zh: 森林大火過後，濃煙籠罩小鎮上空好幾天。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 hung

senses.en: the skill or knack of doing something
senses.pattern: get the hang of it / get the hang of driving / get the hang of things
senses.example: Skateboarding looks hard, but most beginners get the [[hang]] of it within a few weeks.
senses.example_zh: 滑板看起來很難，但大多數初學者幾週內就能抓到訣竅。
senses.note: 固定用於 get the hang of

senses.en: although; used to admit a small weak point
senses.pattern: comfortable, if a little small / pleasant, if noisy / polite, if cold
senses.example: The hotel room was comfortable, [[if]] a little small, and the view was wonderful.
senses.example_zh: 這間飯店房間雖然有點小，但很舒適，景觀也很棒。
senses.note: 後接形容詞或副詞，表讓步

senses.en: an uncertain possibility or condition
senses.pattern: a big if / ifs and buts / too many ifs
senses.example: The team could still win the title, but that is a very big [[if]].
senses.example_zh: 這支隊伍仍有可能奪冠，但那還是個很大的未知數。

senses.en: to have experienced something
senses.pattern: know hunger / know poverty / have never known war
senses.example: Having grown up during the war, my grandmother has [[known]] real hunger and never wastes food.
senses.example_zh: 我的祖母在戰爭時期長大，經歷過真正的飢餓，從不浪費食物。

senses.en: to be able to recognize or tell apart
senses.pattern: know right from wrong / know A from B / would know sb anywhere
senses.example: Even very young children usually [[know]] right from wrong, though they cannot explain why.
senses.example_zh: 即使是年紀很小的孩子，通常也能分辨是非，儘管他們說不出原因。

senses.en: the way someone or something is seen or regarded
senses.pattern: in a new light / in a positive light / see sth in a different light
senses.example: The documentary showed the shy scientist in a completely new [[light]], as a funny and warm father.
senses.example_zh: 這部紀錄片以全新的角度呈現這位害羞的科學家：一位風趣又溫暖的父親。

senses.en: small in amount or degree
senses.pattern: light traffic / light rain / a light meal
senses.example: Doctors suggest a [[light]] meal in the evening, since eating too much can disturb your sleep.
senses.example_zh: 醫生建議晚餐吃少量的食物就好，因為吃太多會干擾睡眠。

gsat.sentence: The traffic in the city was [[light]] today, so Jane got home earlier than usual.

senses.en: to learn something completely
senses.pattern: master a language / master a skill / master the basics
senses.example: Children who move abroad often [[master]] a new language much faster than their parents do.
senses.example_zh: 移居國外的孩子，往往比父母更快精通一種新語言。

senses.en: to manage to control a strong feeling
senses.pattern: master your fear / master your emotions / master your temper
senses.example: She took a deep breath to [[master]] her fear before stepping onto the stage.
senses.example_zh: 她深吸一口氣克服恐懼，然後才踏上舞台。

gsat.sentence: The skill of playing the glass armonica was very hard to [[master]].
He [[mastered]] the instrument and took it to parties and gatherings to play for his friends and acquaintances.

senses.en: very; extremely (formal)
senses.pattern: most grateful / a most interesting talk / most kind of you
senses.example: It was a [[most]] enjoyable evening, and we thanked our hosts warmly before leaving.
senses.example_zh: 那是個非常愉快的夜晚，我們離開前熱情地向主人道謝。
senses.note: 前面用 a 或不加冠詞，不表最高級

gsat.sentence: I’m [[most]] terribly sorry, Mr. Hagen.

senses.en: to amount to a particular total
senses.pattern: number in the thousands / number more than 200 / number about fifty
senses.example: The crowd at the free outdoor concert [[numbered]] more than five thousand by sunset.
senses.example_zh: 到了日落時分，這場免費戶外音樂會的觀眾總計超過五千人。
senses.note: 後面直接接數字，不用被動

senses.en: a song or dance in a performance
senses.pattern: a dance number / the opening number / the final number
senses.example: For the final [[number]], the band invited the whole audience to sing along.
senses.example_zh: 表演最後一首曲目時，樂團邀請全場觀眾一起合唱。

senses.en: a way of expressing strong feelings or energy
senses.pattern: an outlet for stress / a creative outlet / an outlet for anger
senses.example: Painting gives the nurse a creative [[outlet]] for the stress she feels after long shifts.
senses.example_zh: 繪畫讓這位護理師在長時間輪班後，有個具創意的壓力發洩途徑。

senses.en: a place in a wall to connect electrical equipment
senses.pattern: an electrical outlet / a wall outlet / plug sth into an outlet
senses.example: My phone battery was almost dead, but every [[outlet]] in the waiting room was taken.
senses.example_zh: 我的手機快沒電了，但候車室裡每個電源插座都有人在用。

senses.en: a company that publishes or broadcasts news
senses.pattern: a news outlet / media outlets / online outlets
senses.example: Several news [[outlets]] reported the earthquake within minutes, long before officials made a statement.
senses.example_zh: 數家新聞媒體在幾分鐘內就報導了這場地震，比官方發表聲明早得多。

senses.en: all the persons of a nation or ethnic group
senses.pattern: the peoples of Asia / a proud people / indigenous peoples
senses.example: The museum displays tools and clothing made by the native [[peoples]] of the Arctic.
senses.example_zh: 這間博物館展出北極地區各原住民族製作的工具和服飾。

senses.en: to live in a place or fill it with people
senses.pattern: be peopled by farmers / be peopled with characters / a thinly peopled area
senses.example: The remote valley was once [[peopled]] by farmers who grew rice on its steep hillsides.
senses.example_zh: 曾有農民居住於這座偏遠山谷，在陡峭的山坡上種稻。

gsat.sentence: Critics of the country say that drinking is almost an inherent trait of the Russian [[people]].

senses.en: to control an activity by making sure rules are followed
senses.pattern: police the internet / police the industry / police itself
senses.example: Online platforms are expected to [[police]] their own sites and remove harmful posts quickly.
senses.example_zh: 外界期待網路平台監督、管制自己的網站，並迅速移除有害貼文。

senses.en: to keep order in a place using police officers
senses.pattern: police the streets / police the area / police an event
senses.example: Extra officers were sent to [[police]] the streets around the stadium during the final match.
senses.example_zh: 決賽期間，額外的警力被派去維持體育場周邊街道的治安。

senses.en: the best or most active period of life
senses.pattern: in one's prime / the prime of life / past one's prime
senses.example: The tennis star retired in her [[prime]], just months after winning her third world title.
senses.example_zh: 這位網球明星在全盛時期退休，當時距離她贏得第三座世界冠軍才幾個月。

senses.en: of the best quality or in the best position
senses.pattern: a prime location / prime beef / a prime seat
senses.example: The café sits in a [[prime]] location right across from the city's busiest train station.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡館位於最好的地段，就在全市最繁忙的火車站對面。

gsat.sentence: The prickly pear cactus is such a powerful symbol in Mexico that it occupies a [[prime]] spot on Mexico’s national flag.

senses.en: a characteristic or feature of a person or thing
senses.pattern: leadership qualities / personal qualities / have the qualities of
senses.example: Patience is the most important [[quality]] a kindergarten teacher can have, according to the school's principal.
senses.example_zh: 根據該校校長的說法，耐心是幼兒園老師所能具備最重要的特質。
senses.note: 此義為可數名詞，常用複數

gsat.sentence: Girls’ names such as Faith, Patience, and Sophie (wisdom) are chosen because they symbolize Christian [[qualities]].
This fire resistant [[quality]] explains why the giant redwood grows to live that long.

senses.en: a customer who often goes to a shop or restaurant
senses.pattern: a regular at the café / one of the regulars / greet the regulars
senses.example: The owner knows all her [[regulars]] by name and remembers how each one likes their coffee.
senses.example_zh: 老闆娘叫得出所有常客的名字，也記得每個人喝咖啡的習慣。

senses.en: ordinary, or of medium size
senses.pattern: regular size / the regular price / a regular classroom
senses.example: You don't need special shoes for this hike; [[regular]] sneakers will be perfectly fine.
senses.example_zh: 這趟健行不需要特殊的鞋子，普通的運動鞋就完全可以了。

gsat.sentence: Sasaki stated in an interview: “Because my thoughts couldn’t be passed on through a [[regular]] phone line, I wanted them to be carried on the wind.”
In this line of work, the person is paid to do daring actions that are deemed too risky for the [[regular]] actor to perform, including jumping from heights, crashing cars, or fighting with weapons.

senses.en: an official list of names
senses.pattern: call the roll / the class roll / the honor roll
senses.example: The teacher checked the class [[roll]] and found that three students were missing from the bus.
senses.example_zh: 老師核對班級名冊，發現有三名學生沒上車。

senses.en: a small round loaf of bread for one person
senses.pattern: a bread roll / a dinner roll / a roll with butter
senses.example: For breakfast, the hotel served warm [[rolls]] with butter and homemade strawberry jam.
senses.example_zh: 飯店早餐供應溫熱的小圓麵包，搭配奶油和自製草莓果醬。

senses.en: (of a place) to have enough seats for
senses.pattern: seat 500 people / seat up to eight / a hall that seats
senses.example: The new concert hall [[seats]] two thousand people and has excellent sound from every row.
senses.example_zh: 新的音樂廳可容納兩千人就座，而且每一排的音響效果都極佳。
senses.note: 主詞為場所或車輛，不用進行式

senses.en: an official position as a member of a council or board
senses.pattern: win a seat / lose a seat / a seat on the board
senses.example: After a close vote, Kevin won a [[seat]] on the student council for the coming year.
senses.example_zh: 經過票數接近的投票，凱文贏得下一學年學生會的一個席位。

senses.en: to send goods by any means of transport
senses.pattern: ship an order / ship goods overseas / ship by air
senses.example: Orders placed before noon are usually [[shipped]] by truck on the same day.
senses.example_zh: 中午前下的訂單，通常當天就會以卡車出貨運送。
senses.note: 不限船運，陸運、空運皆可用

senses.en: not busy; with little business activity
senses.pattern: business is slow / a slow season / a slow day / a slow month
senses.example: Business is always [[slow]] in February, so the shop owner takes her vacation then.
senses.example_zh: 二月的生意總是很清淡，所以店主都在那時休假。

senses.en: taking a long time to act or respond
senses.pattern: be slow to respond / be slow to react / be slow in doing
senses.example: The company was [[slow]] to respond to complaints, and many customers switched to other brands.
senses.example_zh: 該公司遲遲不回應客訴，許多顧客因而改用其他品牌。

gsat.sentence: The French were also [[slow]] to accept forks, for using them was thought to be awkward.

senses.en: to make thread, or (of a spider) a web
senses.pattern: spin a web / spin thread / spin wool into yarn
senses.example: The spider [[spun]] a new web between the two branches overnight to catch flying insects.
senses.example_zh: 那隻蜘蛛一夜之間就在兩根樹枝間結了一張新網來捕捉飛蟲。

senses.en: a way of presenting information to influence opinion
senses.pattern: put a positive spin on / put a new spin on / a different spin
senses.example: The coach tried to put a positive [[spin]] on the loss by praising the team's effort.
senses.example_zh: 教練稱讚球隊的努力，試圖為這場敗仗找個正面的說法。
senses.note: 常用 put a … spin on

senses.en: to go somewhere quickly and angrily
senses.pattern: storm out of the room / storm off / storm into the office
senses.example: After arguing with his sister, Tom [[stormed]] out of the room and slammed the door.
senses.example_zh: 和妹妹吵架後，湯姆氣沖沖地走出房間，用力甩上門。
senses.note: 後接 out、off、into 等表方向

senses.en: to attack a place suddenly with force
senses.pattern: storm a castle / storm the building / storm the beach
senses.example: In the film, soldiers [[storm]] the castle at dawn and rescue the captured villagers.
senses.example_zh: 電影中，士兵在黎明時猛攻城堡，救出被俘的村民。

gsat.sentence: They [[stormed]] away and never played on the street again.

senses.en: cheerful and happy
senses.pattern: a sunny personality / a sunny smile / a sunny disposition
senses.example: With her [[sunny]] personality, the new nurse quickly became a favorite among the young patients.
senses.example_zh: 這位新來的護理師個性開朗，很快就成為小病人最喜歡的人。

senses.en: to take care of someone or something
senses.pattern: tend a garden / tend the sick / tend sheep / tend to a patient
senses.example: Every morning before school, Ming helps his grandfather [[tend]] the vegetables in their small garden.
senses.example_zh: 每天早上上學前，小明都會幫爺爺照料他們小菜園裡的蔬菜。

gsat.sentence: The baby panda Yuan Zai at the Taipei Zoo was separated from her mother because of a minor injury that occurred during her birth. She was [[tended]] by zookeepers for a while.

senses.en: the amount of data or visits on a network
senses.pattern: web traffic / internet traffic / drive traffic to a site
senses.example: After the video went viral, [[traffic]] to the museum's website doubled in a single week.
senses.example_zh: 影片爆紅後，博物館網站的流量在一週內就增加了一倍。

senses.en: to buy and sell something illegally
senses.pattern: traffic in drugs / traffic in wildlife / human trafficking
senses.example: The gang was arrested for [[trafficking]] in rare birds caught illegally in the rainforest.
senses.example_zh: 該幫派因非法買賣在雨林中違法捕捉的珍稀鳥類而遭逮捕。

senses.en: a tube carrying blood through the body
senses.pattern: blood vessels / a blocked vessel / a burst blood vessel
senses.example: Regular exercise keeps your blood [[vessels]] flexible and lowers the risk of heart disease.
senses.example_zh: 規律運動能讓血管保持彈性，並降低罹患心臟病的風險。

senses.en: a container for holding liquids
senses.pattern: a drinking vessel / a clay vessel / a pressure vessel
senses.example: Scientists found a clay [[vessel]] that had been used to store olive oil two thousand years ago.
senses.example_zh: 科學家發現了一個兩千年前用來儲存橄欖油的陶製容器。

senses.en: a legal document about your property after death
senses.pattern: make a will / leave sth in a will / a last will
senses.example: In his [[will]], the old farmer left all of his land to the village school.
senses.example_zh: 老農夫在遺囑中把所有土地都留給了村裡的學校。

senses.en: the mental power to decide and act
senses.pattern: the will to live / free will / against one's will / strength of will
senses.example: Despite the pain in her knee, the runner finished the race through sheer strength of [[will]].
senses.example_zh: 儘管膝蓋疼痛，這位跑者仍憑著過人的意志力跑完全程。

quiz.stem: For many teenagers, playing in a band provides a healthy ______ for the stress and anger that build up during exam season.
quiz.explain_zh: outlet＝（情緒的）發洩途徑。玩樂團讓青少年抒發考季累積的壓力與怒氣。

quiz.stem: After the earthquake, volunteer nurses ______ the injured in a school gym, cleaning their wounds and giving them water until the ambulances arrived.
quiz.explain_zh: tend＝照料。志工護理師在體育館照顧傷患，直到救護車抵達。

quiz.stem: The first few minutes after a person's heart stops are ______; without immediate help, the patient is unlikely to survive.
quiz.explain_zh: critical＝關鍵的。心跳停止後的頭幾分鐘決定病人能否存活。

quiz.stem: The noodle shop has been open for forty years, and many of its ______ have eaten there every week since they were children.
quiz.explain_zh: regular＝常客。麵店許多老主顧從小就每週來吃。

quiz.stem: The school's new auditorium can ______ up to eight hundred people, so the entire student body is able to attend assemblies together.
quiz.explain_zh: seat＝可容納…人就座。新禮堂坐得下八百人，全校可一起集會。

quiz.stem: Although Ms. Chen never raises her voice in class, she ______ great respect from her students because she always keeps her promises.
quiz.explain_zh: command＝博得（尊敬）。陳老師從不大聲說話，卻深受學生敬重。

quiz.stem: After spending a week volunteering at a nursing home, Kevin began to see his own grandparents in a new ______ and visited them more often.
quiz.explain_zh: light＝（看待事物的）角度。凱文到安養院當志工後，對自己的祖父母有了新的看法。

quiz.stem: The speaker had to pause in the middle of her talk when a sudden ______ of coughing left her unable to say a word.
quiz.explain_zh: fit＝（咳嗽等）一陣發作。講者突然一陣猛咳，話都說不出來，只好暫停演講。

quiz.stem: Even after failing the audition twice, Lily kept her ______ outlook and told her friends that she would surely succeed the third time.
quiz.explain_zh: sunny＝開朗的、樂觀的。莉莉兩度落選仍保持樂觀，相信第三次會成功。

quiz.stem: The twin sisters are easy to tell apart because one has dark brown hair like their father, while the other has ______ hair like their mother.
quiz.explain_zh: fair＝（髮色）淺的、金色的。雙胞胎一個像爸爸是深褐色頭髮，另一個像媽媽是淺色頭髮。
